name: boolean_disjunction
description: Evaluate Python disjunctions of True/False literals. Matched controls copy a True/False tag from the same expressions.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 k=random.choice([2,3,4]);v=[False]*k
 if i%2:
  v[random.randrange(k)]=True
 expr=' or '.join(map(str,v));tag=random.choice([False,True]);prefix=f'Python expression: {expr}\nTag: {tag}\n'
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'What is the value of the expression? Answer True or False:', 'answer':' '+str(any(v))})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'What is the tag? Answer True or False:', 'answer':' '+str(tag)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
